'''''Fate of the Jedi: Vortex''''' by [[Troy Denning]] is the sixth novel in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series and was released on [[November 30]], [[2010]].<ref name="Vortex Harcover" /> At the end of the book, it has an introduction to ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''. The audio version is narrated by [[Marc Thompson]]. The paperback was released on [[March 27]], [[2012]].
